newsitem.title: USA: SunRiver Data renamed with product launch.
newsitem.headline: SunRiver Data renamed with product launch.

text.p: SunRiver Data Systems, a subsidiary of SunRiver Corp, said on Monday it changed its name to Boundless Technologies Inc to reflect its introduction of a line of network computers.
Boundless Technologies network computers will "eliminate the restrictive bounds of traditional computing," said Gerald Youngblood, chief executive.
The computers are priced at about $649 each, with the actual cost depending upon the specific model and configuration selected.
Boundless, a provider of computing access products and services, has its U.S. headquarters in Austin, Texas. It also maintains international headquarters in the Netherlands and Austria.
The parent company intends to change its name to Boundless Corp, pending stockholder approval.
